def factor_volume_confirmed_momentum(df):
    df_copy = df.copy()
    close = df_copy["close"]
    volume = df_copy["volume"]
    # 10-day momentum
    mom = close.pct_change(10)
    # volume conviction: ratio to 20-day mean
    vol_mean = volume.rolling(20, min_periods=20).mean()
    vol_ratio = volume / vol_mean.replace(0, np.nan)
    # smooth weight: log transformation to reduce outlier impact
    weight = np.log(vol_ratio.clip(lower=0.5, upper=2.0)) + 1.0
    factor = mom * weight
    df_copy["factor_volume_confirmed_momentum"] = factor
    return df_copy["factor_volume_confirmed_momentum"]
description: Price momentum is more reliable when accompanied by high trading volume, indicating conviction. This factor weights the 10-day return by a volume conviction factor (log of volume relative to its 20-day mean), amplifying momentum on high volume days and reducing on low volume days. Replaces the previous multiplicative z-score approach with a single robust mechanism.
